
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(scales)


seekdeep_output_tes_1 <- readr::read_tsv("../data/WGS/Input/seekdeep_output_tes.tsv")

metadata_tes <- seekdeep_output_tes_1 %>%
  select(Sample, Treatment) %>%
  distinct()
wide_sample_tes <- seekdeep_output_tes_1 %>%
  mutate(
    mutation_status = ifelse(reference_AA == AA, "wildtype", "mutant"),
    mutation_test = ifelse(
      reference_AA == AA,
      paste0("0", "(", AA_freq, ")"),
      paste0(reference_AA, reference_AA_pos, AA, "(", AA_freq, ")")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, Gene, reference_AA_pos, mutation_test) %>%
  group_by(Gene, reference_AA_pos, Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mutation_test = paste(unique(mutation_test), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(metadata_tes, by = "Sample")


totals <- wide_sample_tes %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(total_samples = n_distinct(Sample))

# Mutation frequencies
px1_target <- wide_sample_tes%>%
#   filter(Gene == "PX1", reference_AA_pos %in% c("1222", "1701", "1705")) %>%
  select(Sample, Gene, reference_AA_pos, mutation_test, Treatment) %>%
  # pivot_wider(names_from = reference_AA_pos, values_from = mutation_test) %>%
  mutate(
    mutation = case_when(
      grepl("D1705N", mutation_test) ~ "D1705N",
      grepl("L1222P", mutation_test) ~ "L1222P",
      grepl("M1701I", mutation_test) ~ "M1701I",
      TRUE ~ "WT"
    )
  )%>%
  select(-mutation_test)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = reference_AA_pos, values_from = mutation) %>%

  mutate(haplotype = paste(`1222`, `1701`, `1705`, sep = "/")) %>%
  select(Sample, haplotype, Treatment)%>%
  left_join(totals, by = "Treatment") %>%
  group_by(Treatment, haplotype,total_samples) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")%>%
  mutate(freq = count / total_samples)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Set treatment order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
px1_target$Treatment <- factor(
  px1_target$Treatment,
  levels = c("Ts", "Tf0", "Tf")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create stacking positions
#    Lowest frequency = bottom
#    Highest frequency = top
# ---------------------------------------------------------
px1_target <- px1_target %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  arrange(freq, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = cumsum(freq) - freq,
    ymax = cumsum(freq),
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#
# 
ggsave(
  filename = "../data/WGS/Results/PX1_haplotype_barplot.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(px1_target, aes(x = Treatment)) +

  # Stacked bars
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = as.numeric(Treatment) - 0.35,
      xmax = as.numeric(Treatment) + 0.35,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      fill = haplotype
    )
  ) +

  # Count / total labels
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = ymid,
      label = paste0(count, "/", total_samples)
    ),
    size = 4,
    color = "white"
  ) +

  # Y axis: percentage
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  # X-axis labels
scale_x_discrete(
  labels = c(
    "Ts"  = "Treatment\nSuccess\n(Day 0)",
    "Tf0" = "Treatment\nSuccess\n(Day 0)",
    "Tf"  = "Treatment\nFailure\n(Day of failure)"
  )
) +

  # Your colors
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "WT/WT/WT" = "#66c2a5",
      "WT/M1701I/WT" = "#fc8d62",
      "L1222P/M1701I/D1705N" = "#8da0cb",
      "NA/M1701I/D1705N" = "#e78ac3"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "Haplotype"
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    size = 14,
    lineheight = 1.0
  ),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
)
  dev.off()
```
